key_developments: US intelligence warns Iran is developing plans to target senior Trump administration officials with a dirty bomb or chemical weapon in Washington, DC, per seven officials cited by CNN. (Source: @shin_persian/12451)

US officials believe Iran has likely pre-positioned nuclear or chemical materials inside the US for potential addition to conventional weapons, based on intercepted chatter. (Source: @Faytuks_Network/10131)

IRGC claims attacks on US Army radar system in Bahrain and a ship near Oman, coinciding with Bahrain emergency warning and subsequent all-clear. (Source: @yediotnews25/137977, @yediotnews25/137985, @shin_persian/12454, @shin_persian/12455)

Iranian missile launches from 15 Khordad Garrison in Isfahan, jet activity over western Tehran, and smoke column observed indicate heightened air defense readiness. (Source: @shin_persian/12458, @shin_persian/12453, @shin_persian/12457)
IDF conducts unprecedented home demolition in Ramallah for West Bank rocket production by captured terror cell, signaling expanded deterrence against non-lethal threats. (Source: @manniefabian/59532)

Two car ramming attacks in West Bank — near Jericho (two wounded) and Tapuah Junction (two settlers injured at illegal outpost) — highlight persistent low-tech threat. (Source: @amitsegal/67281, @manniefabian/59534)

Israeli troops detain two Lebanese brothers in Shebaa; Lebanese army explosions and artillery shelling in Tir Dibba, Zoutar Al-Sharqiya, and Wadi Al-Hujeir signal volatile border. (Source: @manniefabian/59533, @redlinkleb/53589, @redlinkleb/53552, @redlinkleb/53547)
sections.threat_assessment: Iran's alleged planning of a dirty bomb or chemical attack on US soil represents a significant escalation in asymmetric threat posture, while simultaneous missile launches from Isfahan and air activity over Tehran suggest coordinated readiness drills. The IRGC's claimed strikes on US assets in Bahrain and near Oman demonstrate willingness to target American interests regionally. Israel's unprecedented demolition for non-lethal rocket production indicates a lowered threshold for preemptive action in the West Bank. Concurrent car ramming attacks and Lebanese border volatility point to a multi-front pressure campaign.
sections.regional_response: Bahrain's emergency warning and subsequent all-clear reflect acute concern over Iranian missile and drone threats to Gulf security. Israel's political leadership is pressing for urgent Knesset discussion on Iranian threat readiness, while Herzog frames Israel as a strategic barrier for Europe. The IDF's expanded demolition policy and cross-border detentions signal a more aggressive deterrence doctrine. Arab state responses remain unreported in current data.
sections.intelligence_notes: US intelligence community appears divided on credibility of Iranian chatter regarding pre-positioned materials, but assesses the threat as plausible enough to warrant operational attention. The 120-second delayed reporting from Iranian airspace monitors suggests reliance on open-source or semi-open collection. The IRGC's public claims of radar and ship attacks may serve deterrence signaling as much as operational reporting. West Bank rocket production capability, though intercepted, marks a technological escalation for Palestinian militant groups.
